prompt: An elderly archmage in deep indigo robes with gold-thread embroidery, long white beard, standing at the center with one hand raised, channeling streams of cyan magical light onto two younger hooded apprentice wizards who flank him on either side, both fully visible and glowing faintly blue as the empowerment fills them. Three figures total, the central elder taller. The background is a dim vaulted stone academy hall lit by floating blue arcane orbs.

An old archmage in deep blue robes with gold trim and a long grey beard, hunched over an open glowing spellbook on a wooden lectern. A bright fresh page of cyan light flies into his outstretched hand from a floating tome, while a spent page crumbles into orange embers and drifts away from his other side. The only strong light is the cyan glow of the incoming page. The background is a shadowy wizard study lined with bookshelves.

A severe elderly archmage with a long white beard, seated on a carved stone throne, wearing wine-purple and deep blue robes layered with gold-thread sigils. Above his open upturned palm hovers a swirling cerulean sphere of arcane knowledge. He gazes forward with cold authority, the patriarch of an order of mages. The background is a dim arcane library of towering bookshelves lit by faint blue candlelight.

An elderly master wizard in a flowing sapphire robe with gold embroidery, side profile facing west, arms spread wide as cyan arcane energy pours from his fingertips toward two kneeling young robed apprentices before him who are wreathed in the same blue glow, visibly strengthened. The master is larger and elevated above them. The background is a torch-lit stone temple interior with tall columns.

A grey-bearded archmage in indigo and gold robes stands amid a swirling cyclone of floating parchment pages and open books, one glowing cyan page sweeping into his raised hand while a blackened page burns to ash and spirals away. His eyes glow faint blue. The whirl of pages surrounds him fully. The background is a dark stone tower study with arched windows showing night sky.

Close portrait of an ancient archmage, deeply lined face, long white beard, wearing a high-collared deep blue robe with gold filigree and a tall scholarly cap. He holds a small glowing cyan rune-stone between two fingers, studying it with sharp pale eyes. Cyan light underlights his face. The background is a blurred dim library of bookshelves and a single warm candle.

An elderly archmage patriarch in a deep blue robe with heavy gold embroidery and a long white beard, standing tall with both arms raised, cyan arcane runes orbiting his hands. On either side of him a younger robed wizard apprentice glows blue and floats slightly off the ground, lifted and empowered by his magic. Three figures, the elder centered and largest. The background is a grand dim arcane hall with glowing blue stained-glass windows.

An old archmage in sapphire and gold robes with a long grey beard, three-quarter view, calmly plucking a single glowing cyan card of light out of the air with one hand while letting a dull grey card slip from his other hand to fall away. A neat halo of floating cards encircles his head. The only bright light is the cyan card. The background is a tidy candlelit study with a tall bookshelf.

A commanding elderly archmage in flowing indigo robes trimmed with gold, long white beard, standing at the head of a long table around which several young hooded apprentice wizards are seated and lean toward him, all faintly haloed in cyan light from his outstretched hand. The patriarch leads the gathering. The background is a shadowed council chamber lit by floating blue arcane lanterns.
